title: Remote UI folder - Local copy location
desc: If you create a folder and point this setting at it, EDCoPilot will keep a copy of all files needed on your remote PC required to run the UI remotely. You can then either copy the whole folder, or use synchronisation software such as OneDrive, to keep the contents in synch automatically). Note this folder will also be updated when required files get updated

title: Remote UI - IP address of server running EDCoPilot.exe
desc: Set this to the IP address of the server running EDCoPilot.exe eg. 192.168.0.x

title: Set focus on game when Remote UI control buttons are pressed
desc: Whether the main process should attempt to refocus on the game before pressing keys to execute commandes, when you press a button on the Control Boards

title: Verbal confirmation when Remote UI control buttons are pressed
desc: Whether to issue a 'confirmed Commander' confirmation when you press a button on the Control Boards

title: Audio confirmation when Remote UI control buttons are pressed
desc: Whether to play an audio confirmation when you press a button on the Control Boards (plays EDCoPilot.ControlBoardButtonConfirm.wav
